title: Aapka Bunti

vibeProfile.oneLine: A young boy caught in his parents' separation, in a beloved Hindi novel.

summary: Aapka Bunti is one of the most acclaimed Hindi novels of its era, telling the story of a sensitive young boy, Bunti, caught in the emotional wreckage of his parents' separation and remarriage. Mannu Bhandari renders a child's bewilderment and hurt with piercing tenderness, making the novel a landmark portrait of divorce and its effect on children in modern India. Restrained, moving and psychologically acute, it remains a much-loved classic of post-independence Hindi fiction.
whyReadIt: A piercing, tender Hindi classic seen through a child caught in his parents' divorce. Restrained and deeply moving.

funFacts.text: It is considered one of the most important Hindi novels dealing with a child's inner world.
